fieldValues.title: Must relation integrity constraints come before a graph surface?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (4. Relation integrity: what is done and what is missing), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Constraints first: acyclicity, cardinality and endpoint types are declared before any walk or view.
- B. Surface first: ship one-hop selection and views, add constraints as problems appear.
- C. Together, per relation type: a type gains a surface when its constraints are declared.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether walks or views give wrong answers on today's data: the concept graph already has three two-cycles.
fieldValues.next_action: Run a bounded walk over the spec's depends-on graph and the programme's relations and record where cycles or bad endpoints change the result.
